hints.title: Edge Weight Formulation
hints.text: Treat each subdivided edge with count intermediate nodes as a weighted edge of weight count plus one.

hints.title: Shortest Distances to Original Nodes
hints.text: Find shortest path distances from node zero to all original graph vertices using move budget as maximum allowable distance.

hints.title: Internal Node Coverage Sum
hints.text: For each edge (u, v), calculate reachable subdivided nodes from end u and from end v, taking the sum bounded by original subdivision count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Priority shortest path exploration followed by per-edge internal node accounting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating movement across all subdivided nodes individually expands graph to millions of nodes.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Adjacency list and distance map scale with vertices and edges.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Transform subdivided edges into weighted edges of length cnt + 1.
